steps.step: Missing recipients: a selected recipient leaves the team; the Edit date dialog says so and offers Remove unavailable recipients while another selected person remains; Use the usual audience clears the selection
steps.expected: The dialog names the change, Remove unavailable recipients keeps only remaining people, and Use the usual audience returns to the default
steps.actual: Saved recipients Daniel Okafor and Ravi Menon (["01a0e6c7-9732-71e1-834c-8452f24236b0","01a0e6c7-9955-7ca2-90c7-758f13a1fe17"]). After Daniel Okafor left the team (setup API), Edit date said "Some selected recipients have left the team and will not be reminded.Remove unavailable recipients" and offered Remove unavailable recipients; selecting it cleared the notice and kept Ravi Menon checked; Save stored ["01a0e6c7-9955-7ca2-90c7-758f13a1fe17"]. Use the usual audience then Save left no checkbox selected and stored [].

steps.step: Personal lead times: the Reminder lead times card under Settings -> Notifications replaces the organization default for this person; This date will remind does not show the personal list
steps.expected: The card exists with Use the organization's default lead times; after switching it off and adding a personal lead time, the Key date dialog still shows only the organization list plus the date's own lead times
steps.actual: Settings -> Notifications shows the Reminder lead times card with "Use the organization's default lead times" (on at start). Switching it off and adding 3 saved the personal list [30,14,7,3,1,0] ("30 days before14 days before7 days before3 days before1 day beforeOn the day"). The Key date dialog then read "Global reminders: 30 days before, 14 days before, 7 days before, 1 day before, On the day" and "This date will remind: 45 days before, 30 days before, 14 days before, 7 days before, 1 day before, On the day": neither shows the personal 3-day lead time, as the guide warns.

steps.step: Next deadline in the Contracts list picks the earliest unfinished Task due date, including an overdue Task, before Key dates and term dates
steps.expected: The Next deadline cell shows the overdue Task, then the nearest Key date after the Task is done
steps.actual: With an open Task due 2026-09-25, the C-65 Next deadline cell read "DOC-032 compat compat-b contract-tasks-and-dates overdue legal_team_member 1790579743967Sep 25 (3 days overdue)". After the Task was completed in the browser it read "DOC-032 compat compat-b contract-tasks-and-dates near check legal_team_member 1790579743967Oct 8 (in 10 days)" (the Key date on 2026-10-08; other Tasks, Key dates and the 2027-07-25 expiry are later). The reviewer re-selected the saved view "My commercial desk" afterwards.
